import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        double x = scanner.nextDouble();
        double y = scanner.nextDouble();
        double n = scanner.nextDouble();

        double bestDif = 1e9;
        double bestA = 0, bestB = 0;

        for (int b = 1; b <= n; ++b) {
            double a1 = Math.ceil(b * x / y);
            double a2 = Math.floor(b * x / y);
            if (Math.abs(x / y - a2 / b) < bestDif) {
                bestDif = Math.abs(x / y - a2 / b);
                bestA = a2;
                bestB = b;
            }
            if (Math.abs(x / y - a1 / b) < bestDif) {
                bestDif = Math.abs(x / y - a1 / b);
                bestA = a1;
                bestB = b;
            }
        }

        System.out.println((int) bestA + "/" + (int) bestB);
        scanner.close();
    }
}
